'''Arie Zaban''' ({{Langx|he|אריה צבן}}; born in 1961) is an Israeli professor of chemistry. He is President of [[Bar-Ilan University]].

==Biography==

Arie Zaban was born in Israel.<ref name="auto1">{{cite web|url=https://afbiu.org/about-bar-ilan-university/arie-zaban|title=Arie Zaban |publisher=American Friends of Bar-Ilan University}}</ref> He served in the [[Israel Air Force]] as a [[McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II|Phantom]] pilot.<ref name="auto1"/><ref name="auto">{{cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Prof-Arie-Zaban-elected-new-president-of-Bar-Ilan-University-490905|title=Prof. Arie Zaban elected new president of Bar-Ilan University|work=The Jerusalem Post }}</ref> He earned a B.Sc. in Chemistry and a Ph.D. in Electrochemistry from [[Bar-Ilan University]].<ref name="auto"/> He spent two years of postdoctoral work at the United States [[National Renewable Energy Laboratory]] in Colorado.<ref name="auto1"/><ref name="auto"/>

==Academic career==
He returned to Bar-Ilan, becoming a professor of chemistry.<ref name="auto1"/><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zabanlab.com/team/prof-arie-zaban|title=Prof. Arie Zaban|website=www.zabanlab.com}}</ref> He was a founding director of the Bar-Ilan’s Institute of Nanotechnology and Advanced Materials for seven years, and was elected to be Bar-Ilan's Vice President of Research in 2014.<ref name="auto1"/><ref>Ina Freedman. [http://www.israel.org/MFA_Graphics/MFA%20Gallery/Israel60/ch7-7.pdf "Small Worlds:  The Nanotechnology Initiative; From Minute Particles Limitless Possibilities: Israel's Nanotech Sector,"] ''Small Worlds''.</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.renewableenergyworld.com/2007/09/05/bar-ilan-scientist-invents-cheaper-way-to-produce-electricity-49834/|title=Bar-Ilan Scientist Invents Cheaper Way to Produce Electricity|date=September 5, 2007|website=Renewable Energy World}}</ref> In 2017 Zaban was elected to be Bar-Ilan's eighth president, succeeding [[Daniel Hershkowitz]].<ref name="auto1"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jewishpress.com/news/history/432562/2019/06/14/|title=Sharansky Becomes Bar Ilan's Guardian of Zion|first=David|last=Israel|work=Jewish Press}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-bar-ilan-university-aims-bringing-home-150-researchers-1001248168|title=Bar-Ilan University aims to bring home 150 researchers|date=July 30, 2018|work=Globes}}</ref><ref name="auto"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.israeltoday.co.il/read/israeli-professor-punished-for-kicking-hijab-wearing-muslim-out-of-class/|title=Israeli Professor Punished for Kicking Hijab-Wearing Muslim Out of Class|work=Israel Today|date=November 1, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php?id=6551&pt=1&pid=988&level=5&cPath=35,983,988 |title=Bar-Ilan Presidents &#124; Bar Ilan University |publisher=.biu.ac.il |date= |accessdate=2020-02-18}}</ref>
